description: Pakistan Aluminium Beverage Cans Limited (PABC) is Pakistan's first aluminium beverage can manufacturer, incorporated in December 2014, with commercial production starting in September 2017 at M-3 Industrial City, Faisalabad. Its annual capacity has been raised from 700 million cans at start-up to 1,200 million cans, and it supplies customers in Pakistan and abroad. The company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in July 2021.
